extras: Requires OmniFocus 3 or later. Advanced features like hierarchy preservation require OmniFocus Pro.
intentEvidence: Send uncompleted tasks from the active Obsidian note to your OmniFocus inbox, then mark them complete in Obsidian.
problem: Users need a way to move actionable tasks from their knowledge base notes into a dedicated task manager like OmniFocus.

relations.evidence: Send uncompleted tasks from the active Obsidian note to your OmniFocus inbox
Inline Dataview-style fields on the task line are mapped to OmniFocus fields

summary: A task synchronization plugin that forwards uncompleted tasks from Obsidian notes to the OmniFocus inbox and marks them complete in the editor.
